children: Urban Outfitters Inc reported third-quarter results for the period ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $1.662B and diluted EPS of $2.78, both up sharply year-over-year as the company benefited from strength in retail and digital channels and a one-time tariff refund that supported gross profit.
Revenue was $1.662B, compared with $1.505B in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 10.5%.
Net income was $240.7M, compared with $143.9M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 67.3%.
Diluted EPS was $2.78, compared with $1.58 in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 76%.
Year-to-date net sales rose about 10.9% to $3.14B, driven by Retail (+8%), Subscription (+31%) and Wholesale (+22%).
Digital channels showed high single-digit comparable gains, with increases in sessions and average order value helping growth.
Brand momentum was led by Free People Group (about 10% comparable gain) and Urban Outfitters (about 8–9% comparable gain); Nuuly subscribers increased roughly 32%.
Company opened 68 net new stores year-to-date and plans 54 company store openings in fiscal 2027; capital expenditure guidance includes $475M for fulfillment, stores and AI investments.
The quarter included a one-time $95.7M IEEPA tariff refund that boosted gross profit; the company is adjusting sourcing, transport modes and pricing to mitigate tariff impacts going forward.
